description:
Stream your Windows PC to any device with native, GPU-accelerated remote desktop.

Remio Host turns your Windows PC into a streaming target that any Remio client (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows) can connect to over the local network or the internet.

Built from scratch with native WinUI 3 - no Electron, no browser wrappers. Full GPU-accelerated H.264/H.265 screen capture, loopback audio, multi-monitor support, drag-and-drop file transfer, clipboard sync, and gamepad passthrough. Runs as a Windows Service so it survives reboots and log-offs.

Includes built-in auto-updates via WinSparkle (EdDSA-signed end-to-end), so you always have the latest version with one click.
Remio Host 2.6.4 - no more connecting to a black screen, and a crash
when ending a session is fixed.

- Fixed: the Host could let your device connect, finish the handshake
  and then never send a single frame, leaving you staring at a black
  screen until your device gave up twelve seconds later. The Host now
  makes sure it can actually produce a picture before it lets a
  session start, and repairs itself if it cannot - so you either get
  your screen or a quick, honest failure you can retry.
- Fixed: stopping a session, or quitting the Host while it was busy
  recovering your picture, could shut the whole app down without
  warning. Those moments are handled cleanly now, so the Host stays
  running and reachable.
